reviews.title: Winning chicken cat treat!
reviews.body: My cats absolutely love the chicken Temptations treats — they come running every time. The flavor is a hit, the texture is perfect, and the resealable container keeps everything fresh.My only real complaint is the amount of crumbs at the bottom. The cats won’t touch the powdery bits, and the last bag had nearly 3 ounces of unusable crumbs that went straight into the trash. Great product overall, but I wish the treats held together better.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 24, 2026
reviews.author: Maria K. Todd

reviews.title: Great treats, just use moderation method in my opinion
reviews.body: Great treats and a reasonable price. Very easy to use and pet friendly. They have a bunch of different flavors. I’m unsure of the healthiness and nutritional content of them. But in moderation I’m sure it’s fine. Don’t give your pet too many of them because I’m unsure about the digestibility of them. I know if my cat eats more than six or so at a time she does get sick. It might not be the treats but you never know. Besides that she loves them and so do the outdoor cats.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 16, 2026

reviews.author: Lady Star

reviews.title: THESE NUTRITIOUS TREATS ACTUALLY SAVED MY CAT'S LIVES!
reviews.body: I knew the cats really liked temptations treats. As a matter of fact I worried about it a little. They would fight each other for them they would wolf them down at the speed of light. And then they would just run around looking for more a little too intensely for my comfort.But then four out of five of my cats got sick. When the weather in Chicago dipped below freezing I started giving warm water and food to the four or five outdoor cats that I really love. Wonderful cats but I couldn't have them in the house for a couple or three reasons that cat owners would know. But I couldn't just not try to help a little. But I'm pretty sure I transferred some kind of disease from one of the outdoor cats to my indoor cats. Normally when this happens it's a straight line they stop eating they stop grooming they stop drinking water. Any cat owner knows what happens after that.I dedicated myself to taking a kitten baby bottle that I bought previously and making sure they stayed as hydrated as I could get them to be. But they just wouldn't eat.Then I remembered that they couldn't help themselves from eating temptations treats. I don't know why it took me so long to think about this but I offered them up to cats that absolutely wouldn't eat any food for days.THEY ALL ATE THEM IMMEDIATELY! I didn't care if these things were healthy or not as long as they were getting something on their stomachs at least their systems were still working. And then I checked the label for real. Full nutrition bunch of protein bunch of fat and most importantly actually nutritious.I don't know what else to say, but if you have cats that are so sick that they're not eating try these treats! No one has ever suggested this to me and it took me awhile to put the idea together in my head. Spread the wordUPDATE: VERY INTERESTING, when the cats become too dehydrated then they don't react to these treats at all which means there's something very wrong. Time to push fluids and in my case I take a kitten baby bottle cut the nipple off at the very top so it's easier to squirt water in their mouth but in a size appropriate bottle and kind way.Basically the message is that if they're not reacting to the treats then probably I'm guessing their mucus glands are so dried up that they're not smelling it
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 7, 2025
reviews.author: Michael Fiedler
